transcript.text:
Thank you all for the thorough responses. Let me lay out where we stand and what I'm deciding.

First, on Leo's rollback access — Ethan, I agree with the parallel-path approach. Please file the access ticket immediately after this meeting and report back on expected turnaround. However, I'm not willing to bet the overnight high-risk migration window on an unfiled ticket with unknown processing time. Given that Marta currently has valid rollback access, I'm going to approve swapping Leo and Marta on the roster: Marta as primary, Leo as secondary. If Leo's access is restored in time and confirmed before Saturday 8 PM, we can revisit, but the published roster will reflect Marta as primary to guarantee we have someone with current rollback access in that role.

Second, on storage failback — Rina, the gaps from 8 PM to 1 AM and 5 AM to 6 AM are unacceptable for an overnight high-risk migration. Since Omar is the only currently authorized engineer and his window is 1–5 AM, we need a parallel approach here too: pursue emergency authorization for a second engineer to cover the gap periods, and in parallel explore whether Omar can extend his availability. I cannot approve the roster for publication until we have confirmed coverage for the full 8 PM Saturday through 6 AM Sunday window. Rina, please identify a candidate for emergency authorization and report back. The roster will be updated to name Omar for the 1–5 AM window and the additional coverage once confirmed.

Third, on customer updates — Luis, the two corrections are clear: update interval changes from 60 minutes to 30 minutes, and Support owns the customer status updates explicitly. I'm approving that correction. On your staffing concern for overnight Support coverage at the 30-minute cadence, you're right to flag it. Per our normal process, personnel availability confirmations are handled through the roster system as a separate follow-up. Please check Support staffing availability for the full 8 PM to 6 AM window through the roster system after this meeting and report back.

So to summarize my operating responses: (1) Swap Marta to primary and Leo to secondary on the published roster — approved. Ethan files the access ticket as a parallel follow-up. (2) Roster corrected to name Omar for storage failback 1–5 AM; full-window coverage gap must be resolved before publication — Rina to identify additional coverage or authorization. (3) Roster corrected to 30-minute update interval with Support ownership — approved. Luis to confirm Support staffing via the roster system as a separate follow-up.

I will not approve the roster for publication until the storage failback coverage gap is resolved. The other two findings have approved operating responses. Please get back to me on the open items so we can finalize.
